desc:
Welcome to Shave the Grizzly! 🐻✂️

A GIANT bear is fast asleep... and Baldwin will pay BIG for his fur. Can you shave him bald before he wakes up? 😴

Pluck & cut fur to fill your bag 🎒
Sell it to Baldwin for Coins 🪙
Buy Scissors, Clippers & a CHAINSAW 🪚
Upgrade your tools 📈
Feed him fish so he keeps sleeping 🐟
Shave him BALD with friends 👥 (up to 4!)
Snap a team photo for your HALL OF SHAVE 📸
Beat Grumbleson to unlock new bears ❄️

LIKE & FAVOURITE FOR UPDATES.
